theorems.name: Submission.arp_rgr_ball_right_inverse
theorems.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (Φ : Rn n → Rn n) (A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn n) (c : Rn n) (r ε : ℝ), 0 < r → 0 ≤ ε → ε ≤ 1 / 24 → (∀ h : Rn n, 11 / 12 * ‖h‖ ≤ ‖A h‖) → (∀ x₁ ∈ closedBall (0 : Rn n) r, ∀ x₂ ∈ closedBall (0 : Rn n) r, ‖Φ x₁ - Φ x₂ - A (x₁ - x₂)‖ ≤ ε * ‖x₁ - x₂‖) → Φ 0 = c → ∃ X : Rn n → Rn n, (∀ w ∈ closedBall c (r / 2), X w ∈ closedBall (0 : Rn n) (3 * r / 5) ∧ Φ (X w) = w) ∧ (∀ x ∈ closedBall (0 : Rn n) r, ∀ w ∈ closedBall c (r / 2), Φ x = w → x = X w) ∧ (∀ w₁ ∈ closedBall c (r / 2), ∀ w₂ ∈ closedBall c (r / 2), 7 / 8 * ‖X w₁ - X w₂‖ ≤ ‖w₁ - w₂‖)
